help.build_directory: Path to the directory where all build files will be generated. Example: 'build'
help.simd_enable: Set to true to enable SIMD optimizations (vectorization). Set to false to disable.
help.simd_default_instructions: Which SIMD instruction set to use. Options: 'avx2', 'avx512', 'esp-dsp', 'none'. Default is 'avx2' if SIMD is enabled.
help.unroll_factor: Factor by which to unroll loops. Higher values may improve performance but increase binary size. Too high values can lead to cache mess.
help.threading_enable: Enable Stalker parallel execution layer (multi-threaded ops).
help.threading_max_threads_enable: Use all available logical (hardware) threads; overrides threading_num_threads.
help.threading_num_threads: Explicit thread count (integer). 0 = auto-detect. Ignored if threading_max_threads_enable is true.
help.threading_posix_enable: Use pthread backend (Linux / ESP only) for affinity control.
help.threading_posix_smt_enable: With pthread backend, allow SMT (hyperthread sibling) cores to be used.
help.enableHyperthreading: High-level alias for enabling SMT siblings; only effective if pthread backend is active.
help.build_jobs: Number of parallel compilation build_jobs. Set to the number of CPU cores for fastest builds.
help.build_target: Build target. Usually 'all' to build everything, or specify a target name.
help.alignment: Memory alignment in bytes (power of two).
help.build_custom_flags: List of custom compiler flags used only when build_profile='custom'.
help.papiDir: Path to PAPI installation prefix (adds to CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH for benchmark metrics).
